name: Lowest Price Tracker
author: Gksoft Dev Team

sections.description:
Lowest Price Tracker helps stores improve price transparency by automatically tracking price changes and showing the lowest price from the last 30 days when a product is on sale.

Features:
* Automatically records price changes.
* Displays the lowest price in the last 30 days for discounted products.
* Lightweight and compatible with most themes.
* Provides a shortcode: [lpt_lowest_price days=”30″].
* Displays a lightweight 30-day price sparkline chart.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install via Plugins > Add New.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Edit and save a product at least once to create the first history entry.
  4. Open a product page with a sale price to see the notice under the Add to cart button.
sections.faq:
Why don’t I see the notice?

The notice shows only when the product is on sale and the plugin has at least one recorded price entry. Save the product once (or update its price) and refresh the product page.

Does it support variable products?

Version 1.0.1 focuses on simple products. Variable product support can be added in a future version.
